The context doesn't include the starter example itself, so I can't confirm which call it uses. The closest match is the persist call in the storage guide, which saves to disk with `storage_context.persist(persist_dir=...)`:

"This will persist data to disk, under the specified `persist_dir` (or `./storage` by default)." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/storing/save_load.md]

So the directory is whatever you pass as `persist_dir`, and if you don't specify one, it defaults to `./storage`. The example in the storing guide uses a placeholder, `index.storage_context.persist(persist_dir="<persist_dir>")` [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/rag/storing/index.md], so it doesn't name a specific directory.
